title: Present terminology governance as federated with international SDOs
requirements:
- Define the TS as a governed capability that may host, federate, mirror or provide access to sources
- Describe the relationship between national SGI bodies and international SDOs (SNOMED International, Regenstrief, WHO-FIC, HL7)
- State that TS and LIMR are core enablers but do not alone guarantee semantic interoperability
- Decide whether and how to reference SNOMED International's offer and the NRC model
- Represent sources beyond the global-national-facility hierarchy (regional, programme, professional, institutional) with governed publication and feedback
- Consider raising federation/synchronisation with ICD-11, SNOMED CT and LOINC to Required and describe it
- Preserve WHO and other publishers' authority over their identifiers
- Address receiving, localising and distributing international releases on their schedules
